question:
Find the curved surface area of a sphere whose radius is 2.8 cm.

(Use pi = frac{22}7)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a sphere, Curved Surface Area (CSA) and Total Surface Area (TSA) are identical.

Direct formula: Area = 4πr²

⇒ Area = 4 × (22 ÷ 7) × (2.8)²

⇒ Area = 88 × 1.12 = 98.56 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 98.56 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 

 

 
 
• 
 r = 2.8 cm
 Sphere

**Given:**

Radius of the sphere (r) = 2.8 cm

Value of π ≈ 22 ÷ 7

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area of a sphere = 4πr²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = 4 × (22 ÷ 7) × 2.8 × 2.8

⇒ Area = 4 × 22 × 0.4 × 2.8

⇒ Area = 88 × 1.12

⇒ Area = 98.56 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 98.56 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Sphere

The volume (V) of a sphere is given by V = (4 ÷ 3)πr³, where r is the radius of the sphere.

Hemisphere

When a sphere is cut exactly into two equal halves, each identical half is known as a hemisphere.

Surface Areas of a Hemisphere

Unlike a sphere, a hemisphere has distinct surface areas: Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πr² and Total Surface Area (TSA) = 3πr².
